model_system: antiferromagnetic insulating Cr2O3 in the corundum structure

key_params.spin_orbit: included for magnetization calculations; omitted in linear-response phonon/Born-charge step
key_params.pseudopotentials: fully relativistic norm-conserving, separable dual-space Gaussian
key_params.magnetic_order: collinear AFM along rhombohedral z axis

headline_claim: total transverse magnetoelectric response alpha_perp = 1.04 ps/m at zero temperature
replication_difficulty: high - requires SOC DFT+U, finite electric fields, Berry-phase/orbital magnetization, and careful decomposition of four ME contributions
